extracted.intended_audience: emerging and established researchers in the social sciences and humanities applying for SSHRC Insight Grants
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting an application to the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC) Insight Grants program, which funds 2–5 year research initiatives in the social sciences and humanities across two funding streams. Includes awareness of competition dates, funding limits, and associated supplements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Insight Grants support research excellence in the social sciences and humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program supports research initiatives of two to five years and is intended for scholars in the social sciences and humanities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding is available to both emerging scholars and established scholars
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program explicitly targets both early-career (emerging) and established researchers; consult applicant-specific pages (Applicants, Co-applicants, Collaborators) for detailed eligibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project duration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Research initiatives of two to five years
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All funded projects must have a proposed duration between 2 and 5 years; this applies to both Stream A and Stream B awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding streams and values (Stream A and Stream B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stream A and Stream B values vary by competition year. Example values shown: 2025 — Stream A: $10,000 to $125,000; Stream B: $125,001 to $500,000. 2024 — Stream A: $7,000 to $100,000; Stream B: $100,001 to $400,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must choose the appropriate stream based on project scale and requested amount. Note that funding ranges can change between competition years; always check the specific competition year details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition schedule and application deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Competition dates and deadlines are published per year (examples: October 3, 2024 (8:00 p.m. eastern); October 2, 2025 (8:00 p.m. eastern)). Next competition opening June 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines include a specified local time (8:00 p.m. eastern). Applicants must submit by the stated competition deadline for the relevant year/stream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit review committees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications are reviewed by merit review committees (link provided). For evaluation criteria and committee composition, consult the 'Merit review committees' page linked from the competition landing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associated supplements and initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Associated supplements and initiatives listed: Department of National Defence Research Initiative; John R. Evans Leaders Fund; Mitacs Accelerate; Sport Participation Research Initiative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These associated programs or supplements may interact with Insight Grants (eligibility, co-funding, or special initiatives); applicants should review each supplement's requirements and how they apply to Insight Grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information / inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: For more information, contact: Email: insightgrants@sshrc-crsh.gc.ca
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants with questions about the program, eligibility, or application process can contact the program email for clarification prior to submission.
